decisions.statement: A task due before the day now open comes due on that day.
The day now open is counted from six in the morning in New York.
A task stating no due date is not moved.
A task already marked done is not moved.
The key saying a task is done is read from the page type moved.
A recurring task is moved as a task happening once is.
The tasks of one page type are moved in one commit.
The moving is done by a workstation timer rather than by a browser opening a list.
A page type whose due date moves on completion alone is moved nowhere here.

definition: an overdue task moved onto the day now open
